title: Divide, Deliberate, Decide: A Multi-Agent Framework for Fine-Grained Egocentric Action Recognition
title_zh: Divide, Deliberate, Decide：用于细粒度第一视角动作识别的多智能体框架
abstract_en: Fine-grained action recognition in egocentric video is challenging for Vision-Language Models (VLMs): actions often differ only in small visual cues, and a single model tends to be biased toward a subset of these cues. We propose Divide, Deliberate, Decide, a fully-local, zero-shot multi-agent framework in which (i) a VLM orchestrator chunks the video and proposes a top-k candidate label list per segment, (ii) an ensemble of heterogeneous VLM specialists, drawn from different open model families, engages in a structured deliberation that includes a peer-consultation round of questions, and (iii) agent rankings are aggregated with a Borda count and the orchestrator re-ranks its own prediction in light of the specialists' evidence. The entire pipeline runs locally with no fine-tuning. Experiments show that our method positively improves zero-shot action recognition performance over the baseline, highlighting the influence of a heterogeneous deliberation step, showing that the gain stems from decorrelated model priors rather than from additional compute.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 egocentric video 中的细粒度动作识别问题。此类任务对 Vision-Language Models (VLMs) 尤其困难，因为不同动作往往只由微小视觉线索区分，而单个模型容易偏向某一类线索。作者提出 Divide, Deliberate, Decide，一个完全本地运行、零样本的多智能体框架：首先由一个 VLM orchestrator 将视频切分为片段，并为每个片段提出 top-k 候选标签；随后，来自不同开源模型家族的异构 VLM specialists 进行结构化讨论，包括一轮同伴咨询式提问；最后，通过 Borda count 聚合各智能体排序，并由 orchestrator 结合 specialists 的证据重新排序自身预测。整个流程无需微调、无需云端调用。实验表明，该方法相较基线提升了零样本动作识别性能，说明异构模型间的 deliberation 能带来增益，且收益主要来自模型先验的去相关性，而非简单增加计算量。
key_points_zh: 提出 Divide, Deliberate, Decide：一个本地、零样本、多智能体的 egocentric fine-grained action recognition 框架。
方法将流程分为视频切分与候选标签生成、异构 VLM specialists 结构化讨论、Borda count 排序聚合与最终重排序。
核心设计是引入来自不同 open model families 的 heterogeneous VLM specialists，以减少单一模型对特定视觉线索的偏置。
实验显示该框架优于单模型零样本基线，证明 deliberation step 对细粒度动作识别有积极作用。
分析指出性能提升主要来自 decorrelated model priors，而不是单纯依赖更多计算资源。

llm_assessment.comment: This is mostly a zero-shot multi-agent video recognition pipeline and has little lasting value for agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作主要是零样本多智能体视频识别流程，对智能体运行框架演化的长期价值较低。
